title: Yeasty Chewy Ukrainian Beef Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring beef gravy and kombu cold extract, this recipe is kosher friendly and offers a nostalgic taste experience. The yeasty chewy texture of the dumplings is a result of the yeast based dough.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add eggs to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
In a large pot, bring beef broth to a boil and add ground beef.
Reduce heat to low and add kombu cold extract to the beef broth.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 20 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings with the beef gravy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
